$description: The premium character (design language section 19): machined aluminium and glass, understated, soft light, little ornament. A validated theme layer of Instrument tokens over the defaults; an application's theme still overrides any of them. Its values are those of the I1 prototype's second iteration (its look sign-off is pending with the owner); `provisional` names the tokens v2 did not use or measure (docs/ui-library/instrument-spec-notes.md).

switch.$description: Switch's default form; bat, rocker and wall are available as forms.

knob.$description: Knob (design language section 6, Instrument object table).

sweep.$description: The turn from one stop to the other, degrees.

detentScale.$description: A detented knob's size, as a share of a knob's.

dialMargin.$description: The dial box beyond the skirt's diameter (ticks and numerals are printed on the face).

ticks.$description: The ticks' radius beyond the skirt's.

numerals.$description: The numerals' radius beyond the skirt's.

cone.$description: The skirt top's cone: a turned flange that catches the studio's strip, degrees.

ratio.$description: Cap diameter as a share of the skirt's (51 px).

chamfer.$description: The polished chamfer at the cap's top edge.

width.$description: Pointer width, engraved in the cap's ink along the crown.

from.$description: Where the pointer starts, a share of the top's radius.

to.$description: Where the pointer ends, a share of the top's radius.

ratio.$description: A glass cap's radius as a share of the metal cap's diameter (23 px).

dome.$description: The glass cap's elliptical dome, at 50% depth.

hub.$description: The printed hub ring under the dome.

shadow.$description: The share of shadow.strength a glass part casts (design language section 7).

flag.$description: The accent flag's emissive strength when on (hidden when off).

width.$description: Box width: room for the tipped paddle's corners and their drift (#146).

tilt.$description: The paddle's tilt either side, degrees.

length.$description: Lever length; it scales with depth, at most × 1.15.

tilt.$description: The lever's throw either side, degrees.

width.$description: Plate width, inside the box (4 px for its edge and shadow).

crown.$description: The top's crown along its length.

tilt.$description: The paddle's tilt either side, degrees.

box.$description: The box, with room for the halo.

inset.$description: The bezel stands this far inside the box (I0.4).

textGrow.$description: Protected rects are the text runs grown by this.

height.$description: Height above the face, in lens diameters.

strength.$description: Intensity I at the reference cap (40 px).

pointerLight.$description: The pointer light (design language section 3); opt-in per application.

face.$description: The share of strength that lights the face.

stiffness.$description: Spring stiffness per unit mass (design language section 12).

detent.$description: A detented knob or selector settling.

studio.$description: The studio (design language section 4, rendering model 2D.5): application only.

fill.$description: A broad fill opposite the key.

front.$description: A dim panel behind the viewer.

knobCap.$description: A knob's cap; its chamfer the same metal polished.

lever.$description: A bat's lever, polished as a chamfer is.

plate.$description: Wall plates: metal on light themes, gunmetal on dark.

bezel.$description: Bezels of rockers, push buttons and displays; a bat's nut and bushing.

material.$description: The Instrument column of design language section 4's presets: meshes have no captured content, so each carries a base colour (sRGB).

matte.$description: The recipe, in the role's colour.

glass.$description: Glass: a refraction of the capture (rendering model 2D.6); the tint is (0.84, 0.93, 0.9) as 0–1 channels.

metal.$description: Brushed aluminium (no grain on large plates).

gold.$description: Gold, by its base colour; no brush.

emissive.$description: A light source; an emitter when the part is a lens.
